welcome.title: Welcome to Study Korean!
welcome.description: You're all set to start your Korean learning journey. Your progress will sync across all your devices.

landing.heroSubtitle: Structured lessons, spaced-repetition flashcards and vocabulary that sticks — progress synced across all your devices.
landing.featureSyncDesc: Your progress and flashcards follow you on any device — pick up right where you left off.
landing.featureSrsDesc: Words are scheduled with SM-2 so they move from short-term to long-term memory.
landing.featureCurriculumDesc: A carefully ordered course from beginner to fluent, with themed lessons to explore.
landing.regularPricing: Renews monthly at the regular rate.
landing.subscribeCard: Transfer your payment below to subscribe
landing.pendingDesc: We'll approve your payment within a day. You'll get access as soon as it's confirmed.
landing.howStep1TitleDesc: Transfer the monthly amount to the card shown on the pricing card — you can attach a screenshot as proof (optional).
landing.howStep2TitleDesc: Your order is approved manually within a day, granting 30 days of full access.
landing.howStep3TitleDesc: Renew each month. First 2 months at the discounted rate, then the regular price.
